key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns policy mirror descent for terminal-reward LLM reinforcement learning into a critic-free trajectory-level objective using Bellman equations, avoiding intermediate value estimation while preserving the same optimal solution.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a simpler and potentially more stable RLVR training recipe for reasoning LLMs by removing the need for a value critic and using a token-probability-based mismatch correction weight.
method: Derive BPO from Policy Mirror Descent via Bellman equations for autoregressive sequences with terminal rewards.
Replace state-value estimation at intermediate steps with a trajectory-level objective.
Approximate the resulting objective to obtain a practical loss whose correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing that BPO is effective for improving LLM reasoning performance.
watch_item: Because the practical loss relies on an approximation and a smoothed token-probability ratio, training stability and sensitivity to implementation details may matter.
